title: lotus corniculatus subsp. hirsutus
intro: Lotus corniculatus subsp. hirsutus, commonly known as hairy bird's foot trefoil, is a perennial legume native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in reducing oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Lotus corniculatus subsp. hirsutus include antimicrobial, antidiabetic, and antioxidant activities, which have been attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant are thought to contribute to its potential therapeutic applications, including the treatment of various diseases and conditions.
